name: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
storyline: At the start of the 22nd century, an AI known as Mother Sphere is created to advance humanity, but the arrival of monstrous creatures called Naytibas drives humans from Earth. From their orbital sanctuary, the Colony sends elite soldiers down to reclaim the planet. Eve, a soldier of the 7th Airborne Squad, becomes the sole survivor of a failed operation. Rescued by Adam, a scavenger who stayed behind on Earth, she makes her way to Xion, humanity's last remaining city. From there, Eve sets out to hunt the powerful Alpha Naytibas and track down the Elder Naytiba, drawn ever deeper into the mystery of what truly happened to the world.
